notes: One entry per {{Enemy Infobox}} (variants such as 'Jaw Worm (Hard)' are separate entries and share the base moveset). hp.base/hp.ascension are [min, max]; StS1 'ascension' HP applies from A7 (normal) / A8 (elite) / A9 (boss), StS2 from A8. Move effects keep ascension values inline as '(A2: 12)'; damage/hits are the base (A0) numbers parsed from the effect (null for non-attacks or variable damage). intent = schema label from the wiki intent icons (intent_icons keeps the raw codes). pattern = the wiki's prose under the intents table (AI rules, weights, phase changes), plain text, capped at 3000 chars; [Heading] marks a sub-section such as a phase. passives = infobox powers, with the power definition when the page has one. encounters = '<act> <pool>: <encounter>' labels from the encounter lists (pools: easy, hard, elite, boss, event). Excluded deprecated: Doormaker. StS2 is in Early Access (since 2026-03-05); the wiki tracks the public beta branch: last Major Update V0.107.1, latest logged patch V0.111.0 (Beta Patch, 2026-08-13). Values can change between patches. Completeness: enemy counts per category equal the wiki's Cargo 'Enemies' table (106 vs 106); differences against the enemy data module are explained in 'completeness'.

explanations: Doormaker was deprecated in V0.107.1 (replaced by Aeonglass) and is excluded.
Hatchling (Ovicopter's hatched egg) has an infobox/Cargo row but no Module:Enemies entry.
Module has a group entry 'Knight Gang'; the scrape has its 3 members (Flail, Magi, Spectral Knight).
Module lists the Battleworn Dummy as 3 entries (Battle Friend V1.0/V2.0/V3.0 = 75/150/300 HP settings); the wiki page has one infobox 'Battle Friend'.

enemies.name: Assassin Raider
enemies.pattern: Uses Killshot every turn.

enemies.name: Axe Raider
enemies.pattern: Repeats a fixed cycle: * Swing * Swing * Big Swing

enemies.name: Brute Raider
enemies.pattern: Alternates between Beat and Clap, starting with Beat.

enemies.name: Crossbow Raider
enemies.pattern: Alternates between Reload and Fire!, starting with Reload.

enemies.name: Cubex Construct
enemies.pattern: After it Charges Up it repeats this pattern for the remainder of fight: * Repeater Blast * Repeater Blast * Expel Blast
passives: Artifact 1

enemies.name: Flyconid
enemies.pattern: On its first turn, it randomly picks Frail Spores (2/3 chance) or Smash (1/3 chance). After that, each turn it randomly picks one of three moves: Weakening Spores (3/6 chance), Frail Spores (2/6 chance), or Smash (1/6 chance). It cannot use the same move twice in a row.

enemies.name: Fogmog
enemies.pattern: Fogmog always opens with Illusory Spores to summon an Eye With Teeth, then uses Thwack. After that, it randomly picks Thwack (40%) or Headbutt (60%), and cannot pick the same one twice in a row. After a random Thwack, it always follows up with Headbutt. After Headbutt, it always follows up with Thwack, then returns to the random pick.

enemies.name: Fuzzy Wurm Crawler
enemies.pattern: Repeats a fixed three-turn cycle: # Acid Goop # Inhale # Acid Goop Then the cycle starts over.

enemies.name: Inklet
enemies.pattern: The two outer Inklets open with Jab. The middle Inklet always opens with Whirlwind. Alternates between Jab and a random choice (equal chance) between Piercing Gaze or Whirlwind.
passives: Slippery 1

enemies.name: Leaf Slime (M)

moves.name: Sticky Shot
moves.effect: Shuffles 2 Slimed into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Always starts with Sticky Shot, then alternates between Clump Shot and Sticky Shot.

enemies.name: Leaf Slime (S)

moves.name: Goop
moves.effect: Shuffles 1 Slimed into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Randomly picks Tackle or Goop each turn. Cannot use the same move twice in a row.

enemies.name: Mawler
enemies.pattern: Always opens with Claw. After that, each turn it randomly picks one of three moves with equal chance: Rip and Tear, Roar, or Claw. It cannot use the same move twice in a row, and Roar can only be used once per fight.

enemies.name: Nibbit
enemies.pattern: Intent cycles in order. After Hiss their intent wraps back around to Butt, followed by Hesitant Slice and then Hiss again. Starting intent is encounter dependent. [Solo Encounter] When alone (Nibbits Weak encounter), the Nibbit opens with Butt. It's good strategy to aim to win on one of the Butt repeats, so either turn 4 or 7. Nibbit buffs the turn prior, giving you 2 full turns to spend energy on nothing but attacks and finish the combat before the big attack lands. (table omitted) [Paired Encounter] When paired (Nibbits Normal encounter), the front Nibbit opens with Hesitant Slice and the back Nibbit opens with Hiss. (table omitted)
encounters: Act 1 hard: A Pair of Nibbits

enemies.name: Shrinker Beetle
enemies.pattern: Always opens with Shrinker, then alternates between Chomp and Stomp.

enemies.name: Slithering Strangler
enemies.pattern: Always opens with Constrict. After that, it randomly picks Thwack or Lash (equal chance, can repeat). After either attack, it always uses Constrict again, then returns to the random pick. The pattern is: * Constrict * 50/50 chance to use Lash or Thwack * Constrict * 50/50 chance to use Lash or Thwack

enemies.name: Snapping Jaxfruit
enemies.pattern: Uses Energy Orb every turn.

enemies.name: Tracker Raider
enemies.pattern: Opens with Track, then uses Unleash the Hounds every turn after.

enemies.name: Twig Slime (M)

moves.name: Sticky Shot
moves.effect: Shuffles 1 Slimed into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Always starts with Sticky Shot. After that, each turn it randomly picks Chomp (67%) or Sticky Shot (33%). Cannot use Sticky Shot twice in a row.

enemies.name: Twig Slime (S)
enemies.pattern: Uses Tackle every turn.

enemies.name: Vine Shambler
enemies.pattern: Follows a fixed repeating cycle: # Swipe # Grasping Vines # Chomp # Back to Swipe

enemies.name: Wriggler

moves.name: Wriggle
moves.effect: Shuffles 1 Infection into your discard pile. Gains 2 Strength.

enemies.pattern: Wrigglers alternate between Nasty Bite and Wriggle. When multiple Wrigglers are present, they start offset from each other: odd-numbered Wrigglers begin with Nasty Bite and even-numbered Wrigglers begin with Wriggle. When summoned by Phrog Parasite (via Infested), each Wriggler spends its first turn Stunned before beginning its pattern. In the Dense Vegetation event, 4 Wrigglers appear at once, starting their patterns immediately (not Stunned).

enemies.name: Calcified Cultist
enemies.pattern: Always uses Incantation first, then Dark Strike every turn after.

enemies.name: Corpse Slug
enemies.pattern: Cycles through its moves in a fixed order: # Whip Slap # Glomp # Goop # Back to Whip Slap Each Corpse Slug in the encounter starts on a different move in the cycle, so they are staggered.
passives: Ravenous 4 (A9: 5) — When an enemy dies, Corpse Slug immediately eats it, becoming Stunned and gaining X Strength.

enemies.name: Damp Cultist
enemies.pattern: Always uses Incantation first, then Dark Strike every turn after.

enemies.name: Fossil Stalker
enemies.pattern: Always starts with Latch. After any move, the next move is chosen randomly with equal probability: * 33% chance of Latch * 33% chance of Tackle * 33% chance of Lash No restriction on repeating the same move consecutively.
passives: Suck 3 — Whenever it deals unblocked attack damage, it gains X Strength.

enemies.name: Gremlin Merc
enemies.pattern: Cycles through its moves in a fixed order: # Gimme # Double Smash # Hehe # Back to Gimme When the Gremlin Merc dies, its Surprise power triggers, summoning a Fat Gremlin and a Sneaky Gremlin. The Fat Gremlin inherits the stolen gold via Heist.
passives: Surprise — Something is off about this creature...
Thievery 20 — Steals X Gold when Attacking.
encounters: Act 1 hard: Two Gremlins in a Trenchcoat

enemies.name: Haunted Ship

moves.name: Haunt
moves.effect: Shuffles 5 Dazed into your discard pile. Applies 3 Weak.

enemies.pattern: Always uses Haunt first. From the second turn onward, alternates between Swipe and Stomp, always starting with Swipe.

enemies.name: Living Fog
enemies.pattern: Always uses Advanced Gas first, then alternates between Bloat and Super Gas Blast.

enemies.name: Punch Construct
enemies.pattern: Cycles through its moves in a fixed order: # READY # Fast Punch # Strong Punch
passives: Artifact 1

enemies.name: Seapunk
enemies.pattern: Cycles through its moves in a fixed order: # Sea Kick # Spinning Kick # Bubble Burp # Back to Sea Kick

enemies.name: Sewer Clam
enemies.pattern: Always uses Jet first. Then alternates between Pressurize and Jet every turn.
passives: Plating 8 (A8: 9)

enemies.name: Sludge Spinner
enemies.pattern: Always uses Oil Spray first. After that, randomly uses one of its three moves each turn. Cannot use the same move twice in a row.

enemies.name: Toadpole

moves.name: Spike Spit
moves.effect: Deals 3 (A9: 4) damage ×3. Removes 2 Thorns from self.

enemies.pattern: Cycles through its moves in a fixed order: Whirl, then Spiken, then Spike Spit, repeating. In the Toadpoles (Weak) encounter, the front Toadpole starts with Spiken instead.

enemies.name: Two-Tailed Rat
enemies.pattern: Each rat starts with a different move: one uses Scratch, one uses Disease Bite, and one uses Screech. After the first turn, each rat randomly picks from Scratch, Disease Bite, or Screech each turn. Cannot use the same move twice in a row. After at least two turns, a rat may use Call for Backup to summon a new rat. Each rat can only summon once, and the group can summon up to three times total.

enemies.name: Bowlbug (Egg)
enemies.pattern: Uses Bite every turn.

enemies.name: Bowlbug (Nectar)
enemies.pattern: Opens with Thrash, then uses Buff once, then uses Thrash every turn after.

enemies.name: Bowlbug (Rock)
enemies.pattern: Uses Headbutt every turn. However, if Headbutt's damage is fully prevented by a player, the Bowlbug (Rock) becomes Stunned and uses Dizzy on its next turn, then resumes Headbutt.
passives: Imbalanced — If the enemy's attacks are fully blocked, it becomes Stunned.

enemies.name: Bowlbug (Silk)
enemies.pattern: Alternates between Spin Web and Thrash.

enemies.name: Chomper

moves.name: Screech
moves.effect: Shuffles 3 Dazed into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Chompers always appear in pairs. One opens with Clamp and the other opens with Screech. After that, each one alternates between Clamp and Screech every turn.
passives: Artifact 2

enemies.name: Exoskeleton
enemies.pattern: Exoskeletons appear in groups of 3 or 4. Each one's opening move depends on its position in the group: * The first uses Skitter * The second uses Mandibles * The third uses Enrage * The fourth (if present) randomly picks Skitter or Mandibles. * After Skitter, the next move is randomly Skitter or Mandibles (cannot repeat the same move twice in a row). * After Mandibles, it always uses Enrage. * After Enrage, the next move is randomly Skitter or Mandibles.
passives: Hard to Kill 9 — Reduce all damage taken and HP lost by it to 9.

enemies.name: Hunter Killer
enemies.pattern: Always opens with Tenderizing Goop. After that, randomly uses Bite or Puncture, with Puncture being twice as likely. Bite cannot be used twice in a row.

enemies.name: Louse Progenitor
enemies.pattern: The Louse Progenitor repeats a fixed three-move cycle: Web Cannon, then Curl and Grow, then Pounce, and back to the start.
passives: Curl Up 14 (A8: 18) — Gains X Block upon first being hit.

enemies.name: Mysterious Knight
enemies.pattern: Opens with Ram, then randomly picks Breaker (equal chance), Flail (double chance), or Ram (double chance). Cannot use the same move twice in a row.
passives: Strength 6
Plating 6

enemies.name: Myte
enemies.pattern: Mytes always appear in pairs. One opens with Toxic Cornucopia and the other opens with Suck. Afterward, Mytes follow a fixed pattern: # Toxic Cornucopia # Bite # Suck

enemies.name: Ovicopter
enemies.pattern: Always opens with Lay Eggs to summon 3 Tough Eggs, then uses Smash, then Tenderizer. After Tenderizer, it checks how many allies it has. If it has 3 or fewer living allies, it uses Lay Eggs again. If it has more than 3, it uses Nutritional Paste instead. Then the cycle continues with Smash and Tenderizer.

enemies.name: Slumbering Beetle
enemies.pattern: The Slumbering Beetle starts asleep and uses Snore each turn while it has Slumber. Once Slumber wears off (after taking turns or losing HP 3 times), it wakes up, loses its Plating, and uses Roll Out every turn.
passives: Plating 15 (A8: 18)
Slumber 3 — Awakens upon taking turns or losing HP X times.

enemies.name: Spiny Toad
enemies.pattern: Cycles through Protruding Spikes, Spike Explosion, Tongue Lash in order, repeating.

enemies.name: The Merchant???
enemies.pattern: * Always uses Swipe first. * Swipe, Spew Coins, and Enrage randomly lead into 1 of the 3 other possible moves ** Cannot use the same move twice in a row. * Enrage can only be chosen once every 3 turns. * Throw Relic is randomly followed up by Swipe or Spew Coins.

enemies.name: The Obscura
enemies.pattern: The Obscura always opens with Illusion to summon a Parafright. After that, it randomly picks one of three moves — Piercing Gaze, Wail, or Hardening Strike — and cannot use the same move twice in a row.

enemies.name: Thieving Hopper

moves.name: Thievery
moves.effect: Deals 17 (A9: 19) damage. Swipe a card from your deck.

moves.name: Flutter
moves.effect: Gains Flutter (takes 50% less Attack damage, must be hit 5 times to Stun it).

moves.name: Escape
moves.effect: Flees the combat, taking any stolen cards with it.

enemies.pattern: The Thieving Hopper follows a fixed sequence: * Thievery (stealing a card and dealing damage) * Flutter (gaining damage reduction) * Hat Trick * Nab * Escape (fleeing the fight permanently) If it escapes, any cards it stole are lost for the rest of the run. Killing it before it escapes returns the stolen cards.
passives: Escape Artist 5 — Tries to escape the combat after X turns.

enemies.name: Tunneler
enemies.pattern: Opens with Bite, then uses Burrow. While burrowed, uses Attack from Below every turn. If its Block is fully broken while burrowed, it uses Emerging Strike, then starts the cycle over with Bite.

enemies.name: Axebot

moves.name: Hammer Uppercut
moves.effect: Deals 14 (A9: 18) damage. Applies 2 Weak and 2 Frail.

enemies.pattern: The Axebot always cycles Hammer Uppercut thenThe One-Two then repeat. The Axebots spawned mid-fight via Stock opens with Boot Up before entering the cycle. The second spawned Axebot uses the improved version of Boot Up. Every time a new Axebot is spawned it gains +10 Max HP more than the last one (So the first respawn has 10 HP more, the second 20 HP more etc.).
passives: Stock 2 — When killed, a new Axebot is summoned in its place.

enemies.name: Devoted Sculptor
enemies.pattern: Always opens with Forbidden Incantation, then uses Savage every turn afterward.

enemies.name: Fabricator

moves.name: Fabricate
moves.effect: Summons 1 defensive bot (Guardbot or Noisebot) and 1 aggressive bot (Zapbot or Stabbot).

moves.name: Fabricating Strike
moves.effect: Deals 18 (A9: 21) damage. Summons 1 aggressive bot (Zapbot or Stabbot).

enemies.pattern: Each turn, the Fabricator checks if it has fewer than 4 living allies. If so, it randomly uses either Fabricate or Fabricating Strike (equal weight). If it already has 4 or more allies, it uses Disintegrate instead. The Fabricator avoids summoning the same bot consecutively.

enemies.name: Frog Knight
enemies.pattern: Opens with Tongue Lash, then follows a repeating cycle: Strike Down Evil, For the Queen, then a conditional check. If the Frog Knight's HP is below half and it has not yet used Beetle Charge, it uses Beetle Charge once, then continues with Tongue Lash. Otherwise, it uses Tongue Lash and continues the cycle.
passives: Plating 15 (A8: 19)

enemies.name: Globe Head
enemies.pattern: Follows a fixed cycle: Shocking Slap, Thunder Strike, Galvanic Burst, then repeats.
passives: Galvanic 6 (A9: 8) — Powers are afflicted with Galvanized.
encounters: Act 3 hard: A Lone Globe Head

enemies.name: Living Shield
enemies.pattern: * Uses Shield Slam every turn while the Turret Operator is alive. ** Once the Turret Operator is killed, switches to Smash every turn.
passives: Rampart 25 — At the start of the player's turn, Turret Operator gains X Block.

enemies.name: Owl Magistrate

moves.name: Verdict
moves.effect: Deals 33 (A9: 36) damage. Applies 4 Vulnerable. Removes Soar.

enemies.pattern: Follows a fixed 4-move cycle: Magistrate Scrutiny, Peck Assault, Judicial Flight, Verdict, then repeats.

enemies.name: Scroll of Biting
enemies.pattern: Each Scroll of Biting starts on a different move in the cycle. The pattern is: Chomp, then More Teeth, then Chew. After Chew, it randomly picks either Chomp (cannot repeat) or Chew (weight 2), then continues the cycle from that point.
passives: Paper Cuts 2 — Whenever it deals unblocked attack damage to you, you lose X Max HP.
encounters: Act 3 hard: Many Scrolls of Biting

enemies.name: Slimed Berserker

moves.name: Vomit Ichor
moves.effect: Shuffles 10 Slimed into the discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Follows a fixed 4-move cycle: # Vomit Ichor # Furious Pummeling # Leeching Hug # Smother

enemies.name: The Forgotten

moves.name: Miasma
moves.effect: Removes 2 Dexterity from the player. Gains 8 Block and 2 Dexterity.

moves.name: Dread
moves.effect: Deals 13 (A9: 15) damage plus the amount of Dexterity the Forgotten has.

enemies.pattern: Alternates between Miasma and Dread, starting with Miasma.
passives: Possess Speed — When killed, return all stolen Dexterity to the player.

enemies.name: The Lost

moves.name: Debilitating Smog
moves.effect: Removes 2 Strength from the player and gains 2 Strength.

enemies.pattern: Alternates between Debilitating Smog and Eye Lasers, starting with Debilitating Smog.
passives: Possess Strength — When killed, return all stolen Strength to the player.
enemies.wiki_page: Slay the Spire 2:The Lost and Forgotten

enemies.name: Turret Operator
enemies.pattern: Follows a fixed 3-move cycle: # Unload! # Unload! # Loading

enemies.name: Bygone Effigy
enemies.pattern: The Bygone Effigy starts asleep and follows this sequence: # Sleep — does nothing on its first turn. # Wake — wakes up and gains 10 Strength. # Slashes every turn after.
passives: Slow — Whenever you play a card, this enemy receives 10% more damage from Attacks this turn.

enemies.name: Byrdonis
enemies.pattern: Byrdonis alternates between its two moves in a fixed pattern: # Swoop. # Peck. # Back to Swoop, and so on.
passives: Territorial 1 — At the end of its turn, gains X Strength.

enemies.name: Phrog Parasite

moves.name: Infect
moves.effect: Shuffles 3 Infection into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: Phrog Parasite alternates between its two moves: # Infect # Lash # Back to Infect, and so on. When Phrog Parasite dies, Infested triggers and 4 Wrigglers are summoned. They will be Stunned and do nothing on their first turn. The fight continues until all Wrigglers are defeated.
passives: Infested — Upon dying, summons... something.

enemies.name: Phantasmal Gardener
enemies.pattern: All four Gardeners cycle through the same four moves in a fixed order: # Bite # Lash # Flail # Enlarge From the left, the first Gardener starts with Flail, the second with Bite, the third with Lash, and the fourth with Enlarge.
passives: Skittish 6 (A8: 7) — The first time it is hit each turn, it gains X Block.

enemies.name: Skulking Colony
enemies.pattern: The Skulking Colony repeats the same four moves in order: # Zoom # Zoom # Inertia # Piercing Stabs
passives: Hardened Shell 20 — It cannot lose more than X HP each turn.

enemies.name: Terror Eel
enemies.pattern: The Terror Eel alternates between Crash and Thrash, starting with Crash. Because Thrash gives the Terror Eel 6 Vigor, Crash always deals 22(A9: 24) damage from turn 3 onwards. When its HP drops to its Shriek threshold (70, or A8: 75), it becomes Stunned and then uses Terror before resuming the Crash/Thrash cycle. * Terror applies 99 Vulnerable, which effectively makes the player take 50% more damage from attacks for the rest of the fight.
passives: Shriek 70 (A8: 75) — The first time this enemy's HP reaches X or below, it becomes Stunned.

enemies.name: Decimillipede

moves.name: Reattach
moves.effect: Revives with 25 HP (if other segments are alive).

enemies.pattern: Each segment cycles through the following pattern: # Bulk # Writhe # Outgas Each segment starts on a different move, which will remain the case until one or more of them is killed. * When a segment is killed, it uses Reattach to revive with 25 HP provided at least one other segment is still alive. After reviving, it resumes with a random move. which may disrupt their prior synchrony.
passives: Reattach 25 — If other segments are still alive, revives in 2 turns with X HP.

enemies.name: Entomancer

moves.name: Pheromone Spit
moves.effect: Gains 1 Personal Hive and 1 Strength. If Personal Hive is already at 3, gains 2 Strength instead.

enemies.pattern: The Entomancer repeats a fixed three-move cycle: Beeeees!, then Spear!, then Pheromone Spit, and back to the start.
passives: Personal Hive 1 — Whenever this enemy is hit by an Attack, add X Dazed into your Draw Pile.

enemies.name: Infested Prism

moves.name: Pulsate
moves.effect: Deal 8 (A9: 10) damage. Gains 20 (A8: 22) Block and Vital Spark 2 (A9: 3).

enemies.pattern: The Infested Prism repeats a fixed four-move cycle: # Jab # Radiate # Whirlwind # Pulsate
passives: Vital Spark 2(A9: 3) — All Skills are Tainted X.

enemies.name: Flail Knight
enemies.pattern: Opens with Ram, then randomly uses Breaker, Flail, or Ram each turn. Breaker cannot be used two turns in a row.

enemies.name: Magi Knight

moves.name: Dampen
moves.effect: Applies Dampen. While Magi Knight is alive, all your cards are Downgraded.

enemies.pattern: Starts with Power Shield, followed by Dampen. Then repeatedly uses Ram, Prep, and Magic Bomb in that order.

enemies.name: Mecha Knight

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.effect: Deals 8 (A9: 12) damage. Adds 4 Burn to your hand.

enemies.pattern: Starts with Charge and then repeats this cycle for the rest of combat: * Flamethrower * Windup * Heavy Cleave
passives: Artifact 3

enemies.name: Soul Nexus

moves.name: Drain Life
moves.effect: Deals 18 (A9: 19) damage. Applies 2 Vulnerable and 2 Weak.

enemies.pattern: Opens with Soul Burn, then randomly uses Soul Burn, Maelstrom, or Drain Life each turn. No move can be used two turns in a row. All three moves are equally weighted.

enemies.name: Spectral Knight
enemies.pattern: Opens with Hex. After that, alternates between Soul Slash and Soul Flame.

enemies.name: Ceremonial Beast

moves.name: Stamp
moves.effect: Gains Plow 150 (A9: 160). When its HP drops to that amount, it becomes Stunned and loses all Strength.

enemies.pattern: The Ceremonial Beast has two distinct phases. Phase 1: * Uses Stamp on the first turn, gaining Plow. * Then uses Plow every turn. When its HP drops to the Plow threshold (150, or A9: 160), it immediately becomes Stunned and loses all Strength. Phase 2: After being stunned, repeats this three-move cycle: # Beast Cry # Stomp # Crush

enemies.name: Kin Priest
enemies.pattern: The Kin Priest cycles through four moves in a fixed order: # Orb of Frailty # Orb of Weakness # Soul Beam # Dark Ritual

enemies.name: Vantom

moves.name: Dismember
moves.effect: Deals 27 (A9: 30) damage. Shuffles 3 Wounds into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: The Vantom cycles through its four moves in a fixed order, repeating forever: # Ink Blot # Inky Lance # Dismember # Prepare
passives: Slippery 9 — The next X times it loses HP, it only loses 1 HP instead.

enemies.name: Lagavulin Matriarch

moves.name: Soul Siphon
moves.effect: Removes 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity from the player. Gains 2 Strength.

enemies.pattern: The Lagavulin Matriarch starts Asleep with 12 Plating. It sleeps for 3 turns or until it takes unblocked damage, whichever comes first. When it wakes up, it loses its Plating. After waking, it repeats this four-move cycle: # Slash # Disembowel # Slash2 # Soul Siphon
passives: Plating 12
Asleep 3 — Awakens upon losing HP or after X turns.

enemies.name: Soul Fysh

moves.name: Beckon
moves.effect: Shuffles 2 Beckon into your deck (1 into draw pile, 1 into discard pile).

moves.name: Gaze
moves.effect: Deals 7 (A9: 8) damage. Shuffles 1 Beckon into your discard pile.

enemies.pattern: The Soul Fysh repeats the same five moves in order: # Beckon # De-Gas # Gaze # Fade # Scream

enemies.name: Waterfall Giant

moves.name: Stomp
moves.effect: Deals 15 (A9: 16) damage. Applies 1 Weak. Gains 3 Steam Eruption.

moves.name: Siphon
moves.effect: Heals 10 (A8: 15) HP per player. Gains 3 Steam Eruption.

moves.name: Pressure Gun
moves.effect: Deals 20 (A9: 23) damage (increases by 5 each use). Gains 3 Steam Eruption.

moves.name: About To Blow
moves.effect: Becomes invulnerable. Removes Steam Eruption and prepares to explode.

moves.name: Explode
moves.effect: Deals damage equal to its stored Steam Eruption amount, then dies.

enemies.pattern: The Waterfall Giant uses Pressurize on its first turn, then follows a repeating cycle: # Stomp # Ram # Siphon # Pressure Gun # Pressure Up # Back to Stomp Almost every move also adds 3 Steam Eruption. When the Waterfall Giant is killed while it has Steam Eruption, it becomes invulnerable and uses About To Blow, cleansing all its buffs and debuffs. Next turn it will use Explode, dealing damage equal to its accumulated Steam Eruption before dying. * If the Waterfall Giant is killed when it has no Steam Eruption (e.g. via Doom), it dies normally without triggering the explosion sequence.

enemies.name: Crusher

moves.name: Bug Sting
moves.effect: Deals 6x2 (A9: 7x2) damage. Applies 2 Weak and 2 Frail.

enemies.pattern: Crusher repeats a fixed five-move cycle: # Thrash # Enlarging Strike # Bug Sting # Adapt # Guarded Strike
passives: Back Attack — Deals 50% more damage when it is attacking you from behind.
Crab Rage — When an ally dies, it gains 6 Strength and 99 Block.

enemies.name: Knowledge Demon

moves.name: Curse of Knowledge
moves.effect: Each player chooses one of two debuffs to receive. The options change each time this move is used.

moves.name: Ponder
moves.effect: Deals 11 (A9: 13) damage. Heals 30 HP per player. Gains 2 (A9: 3) Strength.

enemies.pattern: Knowledge Demon repeats a fixed four-move cycle: # Curse of Knowledge # Slap # Knowledge Overwhelming # Ponder After the third Curse of Knowledge (once all three status sets have been offered), the cycle changes: Curse of Knowledge is skipped, and the remaining three moves repeat in order.

enemies.name: Rocket
enemies.pattern: Rocket repeats a fixed five-move cycle: # Targeting Reticle # Precision Beam # Charge Up # Laser # Recharge
